input_mode: 81 repeated real t* frames + camera arc
prompt: A real video of man jumping into a water pool, frozen exactly at the highlighted moment: man is fully extended in midair while jumping from a rock into the pool. Throughout this entire shot the subject pose, every object, background and lighting remain motionless. Move only the camera in a smooth rightward 30-degree orbit around the subject, from the original view to a new view with genuine 3D parallax; stop at that view. No body rotation, slow motion, zoom, crop shift, duplicated person, identity drift or scene reconstruction.
negative_prompt: duplicate subject, identity change, distorted anatomy, warped background, camera shake, low quality
